description.narrative: The project is expected to expand access to finance for MSMEs in Argentina and help meet the rising demand for credit, particularly longer tenor loans that remain scarce in the market. IFC also expects that this investmenttogether with IFCs broader engagement in the countrywill contribute to the development of the MSME finance market by encouraging banks to diversify their funding sources, pursue more sustainable growth, and enhance their product offerings for MSMEs. Over time, these improvements should strengthen competition and deepen the overall financial sector.

The proposed investment consists of a senior A Loan to Banco CMF S.A. (CMF or the Bank), for up to US$25 million, to support the growth of the Banks micro small and medium enterprises (MSME) portfolio in Argentina. The Project is structured as a one-year facility, renewable twice for an additional one year each time, resulting in a maximum aggregate tenor of three years. The Project is being processed under the SME Envelope of IFC's MSME Finance Platform (MFP) enabling the Project to benefit from the MFP's streamlined procedure with Delegated Authority.
